note: The denylist is the union of the two the unit tests already pin — packet-shared.test.ts and workforce-batch.test.ts — kept in one place because a field that must never reach an employer must never reach one by ANY route, and two independently-maintained lists drift. These are real column names on SpokesRecord, StudentWorkProfile and Student, so a future 'just add the county' shows up here by name rather than as a silent widening.
termNote: Deliberately field NAMES rather than values. A value ('bus', 'Raleigh') appears legitimately in other contexts, so scanning for values produces noise; a camelCase column name in employer-facing output means somebody spread a record into a payload, which is exactly the mistake this catches.

patterns.why: A student's phone number must never reach an employer through the packet — the instructor arranges contact.
Same: the packet's contact route is the instructor, and the résumé's own contact block is stripped before the PDF is rendered.
StudentWorkProfile.homeZip is not in the packet allowlist and must not arrive through a résumé location line either.

allowNote: The `allow` list on the email pattern holds the PROGRAM's own sender address, which the employer email carries by design — it is who the employer replies to. Nothing student-shaped is allowed through.
